intro: Red Jack Flint is a seasoned human mariner stationed within Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor. A member of the crew of the vessel Maiden's Virtue, he serves as a point of contact for travelers seeking passage or contacts across the sea toward Kalimdor.

p: Found inside the stone walls of Menethil Keep, Red Jack Flint is an experienced seafarer tied to the harbor's maritime trade. As part of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue, he navigates the dangerous sea routes linking the marshlands of Khaz Modan with distant shores. Rather than staying confined to naval routine, Flint directs capable adventurers to allies across the Great Sea, including contacts in Kalimdor like Fiora Longears.
